criteria.requirement: Add Arrow.elapsed(other) returning self-minus-other timedelta on the UTC timeline, and Arrow.shift_elapsed(**units) returning a new Arrow in the original zone/fold. Other must be Arrow or aware datetime; reject naive values. Fixed elapsed units are weeks/days/hours/minutes/seconds/microseconds with finite int/float values excluding booleans; reject calendar months/years and unknown units. Preserve wall-time subtraction and calendar shift unchanged. Retain exact microseconds, negative shifts, subclass construction and natural datetime overflow behavior across DST gaps/folds.
